name: postgres-mcp-server
description: Model Context Protocol (MCP) server configuration for PostgreSQL relational database. Enables AI agents to inspect table structures, verify database migrations, query schemas, and perform safe read-only operational diagnostics.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Execute a SQL query against the PostgreSQL database. In AI agent workflows, this tool is restricted to read-only statements (SELECT, EXPLAIN) with a strict 3-second statement timeout.

sql.description: The SQL query to execute. Example: 'SELECT id, title, status FROM tasks LIMIT 10;'

params.description: Optional array of positional parameter values ($1, $2, ...) to prevent SQL injection.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Inspect column names, data types, nullability, default values, primary keys, foreign key constraints, and indices of a specific table in PostgreSQL.

table_name.description: Name of the table to inspect (e.g., 'tasks', 'users', 'outbox_events', 'idempotency_keys').

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: Enumerate all user tables, views, and materialized views in the connected database schema.

schema.description: PostgreSQL schema namespace to filter by.

tools.name: check_migrations
tools.description: Inspect the schema migration tracking table (e.g. 'schema_migrations', 'flyway_schema_history', or 'goose_db_version') to determine the current applied database version, applied timestamps, and dirty migration states.

migration_table.description: Name of the migration tracking table (default: 'schema_migrations').

security.notes: Connect agents using a read-only database role (e.g., 'readonly_agent') with SELECT rights only. Never grant DDL or SUPERUSER rights to the MCP connection.
